newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Oak Technology cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Oak Technology cut.

text.p: -- Hambrecht & Quist said it has cut the rating on shares of Oak Technology Inc to buy from strong buy, but it is leaving earnings estimates unchanged.

-- In a statement, the investment research firm said Oak's core CD-ROM business continues to be solid. Also, It is showing some signs of product diversification, but that should not impact the company until the second half of 1997.
-- But the company said "we do not see any catalysts for major near term multiple expansion on the stock."
-- Hambrecht & Quist expects the company to report a profit of $0.11 a share in the March quarter.
